steps.text: His clock's stopped and the knot's come loose. Rex and Dash want you in Dash's lab, in the Far Future.
Dash wants everyone at the Tomorrow Clock, in the middle of Lumen City.
Rex says Dash left something for you in his lab.

reward.message: Dash's letter is yours to keep: it waits on his workbench whenever you want to read it again. (+20 sparkles)
